Commentary.Commentary: Can the South African's chase this target? It won't be an easy task by any means, especially against a potent English bowling attack. We'll find out in a while. The wicket has shown that runs can be scored on it, so will be an interesting chase. Join us in a short while for the second half of this match.

England after losing 3 wickets had lost their way a little, but the partnership between Morgan and Stokes steadied the ship for England with Stokes scoring a brilliant hundred after being given multiple lives. Jos Buttler and Moeen Ali came in and whacked the ball to all parts of the ground and helped England reach a mammoth total, which looked seemingly impossible at one stage.

After being reduced to 80/3, England ended up with 330 on the board. They scored 111 runs in the last 10 overs and posted a total which is more than competitive here. The South African bowlers started off really well with the ball but their fielders let them down in the field with 5 catches being dropped.

OUT! A wicket to end the innings for South Africa. But England won't care, they've put up a huge total on the board. From around the wicket, it's fuller in length as Moeen Ali looks to play the slog sweep. The ball takes a big top edge which skies towards short fine leg. Quinton de Kock runs over there and takes it safely in his gloves. With that, ENGLAND FINISH ON 330/6!
Jos Buttler drives this fuller length ball through the covers. One run added to the total.

In the air... But it's safe! Full and outside off from over the wicket, Buttler walks out to paddle it fine down the leg side but gets a big top edge over the keeper's head. Falls safely as the batsmen take two runs.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Full and angling in, Moeen Ali uses the angle and whips it over mid-wicket. Places it well enough and beats the man out in the deep for a another boundary.
FOUR! That's right out of the screws! Bang goes Moeen Ali and starts the over in style. It's full and well outside off, Ali dinks it over extra cover for a boundary.
Andile Phehlukwayo will bowl the final over of the innings.
A low full toss, almost a yorker as Buttler smacks it down the ground. Two more runs to the total.
Moeen drives it to long on and rushes to the other end.
Wide! Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone. The umpire has signalled a wide.

FOUR! That's poor from Hashim Amla. He hasn't had a good time in the field at all. Moeen Ali turns inside his crease and pulls it towards fine leg. Amla tries to settle himself under the ball but doesn't judge the flight of the ball well. It's down on the ground and across the rope.
Short of a good length, on middle and leg, Moeen is in no control as he plays the pull shot. It balloons over but ultimately falls safely in the square leg region. A brace is taken.
Spears a full delivery wide outside off, Buttler reaches out to it and squeezes it towards deep point for one run.
Full in the line of the stumps, Ali drives it down to long on and rotates strike.
FOUR! Shot. Similar to the previous boundary, Buttler pulls it along the ground across the mid-wicket rope.
Swing and a miss! Back of a length on the stumps, Buttler looks to heave it across the line but can only connect with thin air.
FOUR! Shortish in length, Buttler is a bit off balance but still manages to get the pull shot away. Gets it through mid-wicket and away to the fence.
Wide! Way wide outside off, full in length, Jos lets it be.
13th ODI Fifty for Jos Buttler!

A great shot and an equally brilliant fielding effort from Kagiso Rabada. Buttler moves across and scoops it over the keeper's head. Seems the ball will go across the rope but Rabada out in the deep puts in a magnificent dive running to his right to keep the ball inside the rope. Two runs are taken and that's fifty up for Buttler. Great knock so far.
Low full toss on off, it's driven to long on for a single.
Full and around off, Moeen drives it straight back down the ground. It's quite straight and takes some time out in the deep to cut it off, so the batsmen take two. The 50-run stand is up as well.
Chris Morris is brought back into the attack.
Short ball which Moeen Ali pulls away to deep square leg for a single.
The batsman goes after a wide one and misses.
Yorker around off, excellent stuff from Kagiso Rabada. Buttler just about manages to dig it out on the off side for a quick run.
Full ball fired well outside off, Buttler goes after it but cannot make any connection.
Short ball on the stumps, from over the wicket, Buttler attempts to play the pull shot but fails to do so.
From around the wicket, Rabada angles in a back of a length ball on off, Moeen Ali goes for the big heave across the line but it goes off his body behind on the off side. A leg bye is taken.
Kagiso Rabada to bowl again.

FOUR! Jos Buttler is just dealing in boundaries here. He firmly pulls this through backward square leg and ends the over exactly how it started, with a boundary. 22 runs off the over, a big one for England.
Wide! My, my... He's attempting to play the switch hit again, but it's too far outside off. Buttler leaves it and that will be a wide.

FOUR! Three in a row. Sublime innovation from the English wicketkeeper batsman. Has already premeditated the reverse paddle and executes it to perfection. Wait, it's in fact the switch hit. Clears the point fielder and that's another boundary.

FOUR! Consecutive boundaries for Jos Buttler! It's fuller in length this time, Buttler walks across and flicks it through backward square leg. The placement is immaculate as he beats the man out in the deep trying to cut it off.
FOUR! That went like a tracer bullet! Short of a length ball, slower in pace around off, Buttler waits for it and hammers the pull through square leg. There's no stopping that one, great shot.
Slower back of a length ball on off, Ali walks a long way across to play the pick up shot behind square on the leg side. Ends up getting it off his thigh pad for a leg bye.
FOUR! Short, wide and a lot of width on offer, Moeen Ali flashes his bat at this. Clears the point fielder comfortably as the ball runs away to the rope.
Andile Phehlukwayo to have a go with the ball again.

Ooofff! That was quick. Short delivery angling in, rises on Buttler too sharply and he's unable to connect his pull shot. The keeper behind does a fantastic job to rise and take it with is right hand.
Short ball, Ali pulls this away but is no control of it whatsoever. It lobs over mid-wicket and falls safely. Single taken as the man out in the deep comes running in to collect it.
Full delivery on the stumps, Buttler makes room and off the inner half, drives it to long on for one more.
Full on off, Moeen drives it through to wide long off but only manages a single this time.
Fullish in length from Morris, Ali hits it hard down the ground and picks up two for it.
Short of a length ball into the body, Jos pulls it along the ground to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Shot. Moeen Ali gives the charge and lofts it cleanly over the covers to end the over with a boundary.
Reverse sweep played by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Loopy ball around off, Buttler brings out the reverse sweep and places it square on the off side for a couple of runs.

Excellent save from Morris out in the deep. Buttler drives it through the covers and it seems the ball will race away to the fence, but Chris dives full stretch to his left and makes a brilliant stop. Keeps the batsmen to just two.
Moeen Ali walks out to bat.

OUT! Third time's a charm, eh? Keshav Maharaj finally gets his man, one he was cruelly denied by his teammates earlier in the day. Seeing Stokes make room, Maharaj bowls it wider outside off, making the southpaw reach out for it. The batsman looks to clear the wide long off fence but doesn't get enough power behind it. David Miller out there in the deep runs to his right and takes a good catch. Ben Stokes departs, but not before he's played an important knock for his team.
Reverse sweeps the flighted ball straight to point for a run.
Keshav Maharaj is back.
Slower short ball, Buttler pulls it to deep square leg for a run.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Wide outside off, Stokes slashes and gets an outside edge to third man for a run.
2nd ODI hundred for Ben Stokes!
Short ball which did not get the bounce intended, Stokes clips it on the leg side and runs two, to reach his hundred. A very important innings by Stoke.
YORKER, Stokes digs it out to cover.
SIX! RIGHT IN THE ARC! Full on leg stump, Stokes moves the right leg out off the way and heaves it over long on for a maximum. Just two runs away now from his ton.
Chris Morris back into the attack. Can he break this partnership?
Plays the length ball to mid-wicket for a run.
Length ball Stokes gets an inside edge onto the pads.
It's been lofted over Mid on by the batsman. Two runs added to the total. Stokes into the 90s
FOUR! CLUBBED IT! Slower ball wide of off stump, Stokes hits it hard over short covers for a boundary.
Short, Buttler shuffles across and pulls it to deep square for a run.
Comes down the track to take it on the full, drives it wide of long off for a couple.
Punches the length ball on the off side for a run.
50-run stand between Stokes and Buttler!
Driven through mid off by the batsman. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Short ball, Stokes powers it over mid-wicket, where Behardien dives over the ball and concedes a boundary.
Pushes the length ball to cover, where ABD makes a diving stop. He has a shy at the bowler's end but it hits Buttler on his calf. They run through for a single.
FOUR! TRADEMARK JOS BUTTLER! Full seam up delivery, Buttler moves inside the line and paddles it over the keeper to the fine boundary.
Lands on a length outside off, Stokes slashes at it and gets an outside edge down to thrid man for a run.
Powerplay 3 has been signalled. Which means a maximum of 5 fielders will be allowed outside the 30-yard circle.
Length ball which Stokes belts down the ground to long off for a run.
Back of a length ball, Stokes punches it off the back foot back to the bowler.
Outside off, Buttler plays it to point for a run.
The batsman rocks onto the backfoot and punches the ball. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Slower ball on length, Stokes checks his shot and it goes over the bowler's head to long on and they run two.
FOUR! WHAT A SHOT! Back of a length ball, Stokes reverse sweeps and gets a top edge just over the head of short third man for a boundary.
Dwaine Pretorius comes back in to bowl.
Back of the hand slower one outside off, Buttler attampts the cut but does not time it and it goes to covers.
Stokes moves away and gets an under edge to cover and they run a single.
Length on middle, Buttler flicks it to mid-wicket for a quick run. There is a shy at the bowler's end but it misses.
Buttler makes room, the bowler follows him and the batsman misses the flick. It hits his pad and rolls to fine leg.
Lands it on a length, Buttler punches it straight to cover.
Back of a length ball, Buttler cuts it to point.
FOUR! That's hammered! Ben Stokes reaches out to this full delivery and smashes it back down the ground for a boundary. With that, Ben Stokes has made his highest ODI score of 2017.
Looped up delivery on middle and off, Buttler brings out the reverse sweep and plays it towards point for one more.
This time Stokes drives it to long off. Makes room and plays it with ease to pick up a run.
Loopy full ball around off, Jos drives it to long off for a single.
Full ball on middle and it's flicked through the mid-wicket area for one.

From around the wicket, it's floated around off, Buttler makes use of his feet to get to the pitch and drives it straight to David Miller. Luckily for the South African, it came to him on the bounce as Buttler bumped it. Miller spills it and lets it through, single taken. The 200 is up for England as well.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Short outside off, Buttler cuts it straight to point.

NOT OUT, IT REMAINS UMPIRES CALL! Length ball, on middle, Buttler misses the flick and gets struck on the pads. South Africa appeal but the umpire does not give it out and they review straightaway. The umpires go upstairs and the replays show that it was pitching in line, the impact was in line but the ball was just clipping the leg stump so the umpire's call stays. England lose their review.
South Africa have reviewed an lbw decision against Jos Buttler.
Back of a length ball, Buttler pushes it back to the bowler.
Slower ball on the shorter side, Stokes moves away and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Length outside off, Stokes goes for the cut and misses the ball which stays low.
Andile Phehlukwayo is called back on to bowl.
Tucks the leg stump ball on the leg side for a run.
Reverse sweeps it to short third man for a run.
Makes room outside off, Stokes drives the flighted ball to long off for a run.
FOUR! BACK-TO-BACK BOUNDARIES! Tosses it up, Stokes sits down on one knee and slog sweeps it to the mid-wicket boundary.
FOUR! USES HIS FEET WELL! Comes down the track and hits it wide of long on for a boundary.
Shorter ball, Buttler flicks it to the leg side for a run.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Back of a length ball, Buttler lets the ball go through to the keeper.
Length outside off, Stokes pushes it to covers for a run.
WIDE! Attempts the slower bouncer and it bounces way above the batsman's head and the umpire calls wide.
Lands on a length, Stokes guides the ball to point.
Back of a length, Buttler plays it on the leg side with soft hands and they get through for a single.
Bowled on a length, Buttler guides it to third man, where he fumbles and they run two.
Short ball, Buttler punches it to sweeper cover off the back foot for a run.
Comes down the track and flicks it to mid-wicket for no runs.
Flatter ball, Stokes pushes it down to long on for a run.
Uses his feet to get to the pitch of the ball and drives it down to long on for a run.
Flights it up, Buttler defends it off the front foot.
Tosses it up, Stokes drives it down to long on for a run.

There's an ongoing discussion between AB de Villiers and the umpires. The South African skipper isn't happy with the ball for some reason and seems to want a different one. But the two umpires don't agree with him and will continue with the same one.
Short delivery just around off, Buttler has nothing to do with that.
Jos Buttler will be the new man in.

OUT! Edged and he's gone this time! Unlike how the day has mostly gone for the Proteas, they've managed to hold on to a catch this time. Length delivery slanting across, it's a bit fuller than what Morgan expects. Ends up getting an edge as a result as he looks to cut. Quinton de Kock gets low to his left and takes a good catch just inches above the ground. The 95-run stand is broken.
10th ODI fifty for Ben Stokes!
Fifty for Ben Stokes! He's played a good knock here, made good use of the multiple reprieves given to him. Just knocks this full delivery to mid off and takes a quick single.
FOUR! That's a brilliant shot. It's full and in the slot, Stokes hammers it straight back down the ground. Hits it quite straight and sends it across the rope.

FOUR! EDGED AND AWAY! Ben Stokes seems to have all the luck in the world with him today. At 90 mph, on a back of a length it's around off, he flashes hard at this and gets a thick edge. It flies between the keeper and first slip and rockets away to the boundary line behind.
Quite full on off, almost a yorker, Stokes keeps it out by crouching low.

Eoin Morgan is adjusting the strapping on his helmet. It's taking a bit of time and so, we're going to have a slight halt in play. The umpires have seen this opportunity and decided to call for DRINKS. Sensible call.
Quite full on the stumps, it's driven in the direction of the bowler who dives to his left to keep it from going past him.
Beats the outside edge! Maharaj bowls the straighter one and deceives Eoin Morgan. The England captain plays for the turn and hence is beaten.
Full from Maharaj, Stokes drives it to long on for one run.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Full around off, Morgan kneels forward and across to paddle it towards the fine leg region for two more.
Tossed up outside off, Morgan just chips this over the covers. Clears the infield comfortably and gets a double for doing so.
Keshav Maharaj returns to the attack.

Full ball around off, Ben Stokes uppishly hammers the drive to the covers. It actually goes on the bump to Duminy at short cover who dives and gets a hand to it. Good stop, keeps the batsmen to just two.

Another short one to Eoin Morgan, he stays leg side of it and just checks his pull shot. It's in the air for a short while but falls well short of the wide mid on fielder chasing after it. Single taken.
Short ball which is slightly angling down leg, Ben Stokes pulls it down towards fine leg for an easy single.
Wide! Rabada hurls this way, way outside off. It goes across the line as Stokes leaves it alone. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Bit wide outside off, Eoin has room to work with so he smacks it through to sweeper cover for a run.
Good length delivery on off, Morgan makes a bit of room and ends up slapping it towards covers. Didn't exactly middle that, a bit of a miscued shot.
Going across Morgan, on a length, it's blocked with a slightly opened face in front of point.
Kagiso Rabada is back into the attack. He has a slip in place.
A unofficial drinks break, if you will. Eoin Morgan is being looked at after being hit on the helmet on the previous delivery.

Over the wicket for the last ball of the over, it's short and Morgan is hit on the helmet as he goes for the pull. It lobs over down to third man as a leg bye is taken. The English captain has been hit on the helmet quite a few times recently. Hasn't exactly looked quite comfortable against it.
Morris switches the angle and comes from around the wicket, it's angling into Ben Stokes who nudges it 'round the corner for one.
Fuller on middle and off, driven straight back down the track.

SIX! OH WHAT A SHOT! Picked up the length early, made room for it and bang... That's outta here! With a lovely followthrough of the bat, Stokes hoicks it over the wide long on boundary for a maximum. That's what you get for dropping him twice.
Pitches this on a length, around the off stump, Ben defends it on the off side.
Shortish delivery pounded in, on off, Morgan rides the bounce and pulls it along the ground to deep mid-wicket for an easy run.
The batsman guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
Wide! Spills it down the leg side, wide called by the umpire.
Angling across, the English skipper keeps it out from within the crease.
FOUR! Straying on the pads, easy enough for Morgan to put this away. Just tickles it fine down the leg side and helps it across the fine leg fence.
Nicely done. With the full face of the bat Ben eases it down to long on for one.
Just back of a length around off, Ben backs away a bit and slaps it to mid off. No run taken on this occasion.
Full and attacking the stumps, Morgan drives it down to long on. One run taken.
Attempted yorker which just misses. It's a low full toss on middle, Ben Stokes wrists it straight to the short mid-wicket fielder.
Length ball on middle and off, Stokes stands his ground and solidly blocks it out.
Short ball around off, Eoin drags the pull through mid-wicket and gets a run to his name.

FOUR! Morris takes the pace off this but Morgan is quick to pick it up. He waits for this, it's wide outside off. Seeing the width on offer he unleashes the cut past the diving point fielder and picks up a boundary.
Swerving away from middle and off, Morgan meets it with a straight bat and defends it in front of covers.
Good, tight line from Chris Morris. Keeps it very close to the off pole on a length, Morgan stays behind the line and keeps it down on the track ahead.
Good length delivery aiming the top of off stump, Eoin Morgan backs away and with an opened face runs it down to third man for a single.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Works it away to the mid-wicket area for no run.
Outside off on a length, Stokes tries cutting it away but fails to do so.
50-run stand between Morgan and Stokes!
SIX! THAT'S MUSCLED! Sheer power from Ben Stokes. Length delivery from Phehlukwayo, Stokes rocks back in a jiffy and heaves it over the wide long on fence for a maximum.
Full on off, driven to mid on.

Bouncer on middle and off, once again it just takes off and Stokes has no chance of connecting the pull. Quinton de Kock behind the stumps does well to time the leap properly and get a hand to it. A bye is taken.

Chance of a run out! That was a real close one. Morgan drops this one in front of covers and both batsmen hare across. David Miller gets to the ball and has a shy at the non-striker's end. Morgan was struggling and had that hit, even the dive wouldn't have saved him. Single completed in the end.
Sharp bounce for Chris Morris. It shoots off the surface and whizzes past the edge as Eoin Morgan goes for the wild cut.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Connects this time. It's cut away a bit square on the off side for a single.
Beaten! Good length ball outside off, Morgan goes for the fierce cut but ends up hitting thin air.
Chris Morris back into the attack.
Attacks the stumps this time, Ben plays it back down the track to end the over.
Short and wide outside off, Stokes goes for the cut and just about manages to clear the leaping point fielder. Two runs taken.
Good length ball around off, punched off the back foot on the off side.

DROPPED! One more, the 5th one of the innings from South Africa. Although, in the keeper's defense, this was a difficult chance. Angling across on a length, Eoin Morgan has a feel for it from inside the line and gets a thick edge. Quinton de Kock attempts to take it but the ball bursts off his fingers and goes through behind. Difficult chance, it came to him in a flash. A single is taken.
Stays back to this one and keeps it out.
Full and straight from Eoin Morgan, it's played back down the track with a straight bat.

FOUR! Shuffles to the leg side, the bowler tries to follow him, Stokes heaves it wide of mid-on, the bat faced closed a little but the connection was good enough for the ball to reach the boundary. Second boundary off the over.
Back of a length, angled in at off stump, defended off the back foot.
Back of a length, Stokes punches it off the back foot.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side.
On the pads, Stokes flicks it to short mid-wicket.
FOUR! PICTURE PERFECT SHOT! Full on middle, Stokes lifts it straight over the bowler's head for a boundary. Second boundary in the last seven balls.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Wide and full outside off, Stokes leans forward and drives it through off side for a run.
Drifts on the pads, Morgan works it on the leg side for a run.
Back of a length ball, Morgan defends it off the back foot.
Full ball on off, Morgan drives it straight but the bowler gets a hand on it and deflects it to mid off.
FOUR! GOOD SHOT! Bowls it on a length just outside off, Morgan lofts it over mid off for a much needed boundary. That would relive the nerves a little.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
DROPPED! Another chance goes down, Pretorius bowls it full, Morgan drives it back uppishly, Pretorius goes down low gets a hand to it but cant hang on to it. tough chance but should have been taken.
Full and wide outside off, Morgan goes for a drive but gets an inside edge and chops it onto the ground.
Back of a length ball, Morgan drives it to mid on.
Angles it into the batsman's pads, Stokes flicks it through mid wicket for a run.
Lands it on a length just outside off, Stokes defends it off the front foot.
Flicks the leg stump ball to mid-wicket.
Full ball, Morgan drives it straight to mid on.
Strays on the pads, Stokes misses the flick, hits him on the pads and rolls to square leg as they complete a leg bye.
Short of a length on off stump, Stokes covers the line off the ball and defends it off the back foot.
Length ball, Stokes defends it on the front foot.
Starts off with a full ball on off stump, Stokes drives it to mid off for no runs.
Andile Phehlukwayo into the attack now.
Chopped to the ground as he goes for the cut.
Back of a length ball, pushed to mid of.
Big appeal for lbw, maybe an inside edge again...plenty of nervy moments. Given runs as it trickles to third man. Looks like two pads on replay.
Width outside off, square drives through point and the sweeper comes across to cut it and they run through for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Length ball, Morgan defends it on the front foot.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Flatter outside off, Morgan goes to cut the ball but gets an under edge past the keeper for a couple of runs.
BIG APPEAL! Morgan goes for the reverse sweep but gets an inside edge onto the pads. The South Africans go up for an appeal but the umpire is not interested.
Floats it up, Stokes leans forward and drives it long off for a run.
Drives the full ball down to long on for a run.
Tosses it up, Morgan defends it off the front foot.
Length ball, Stokes defends it off the back foot.
Length outside off, Morgan guides it down to third man for a run.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Bowled on leg stump, Stokes flicks it to mid-wicket for a run.
Comes down the track, the bowler goes full on leg stump. It hits Stokes on the pad and rolls to fine leg. They run two leg byes.
Full ball, driven to sweeper cover for a run.
Works it off his pads and flicks it away on the leg side.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Some sharp bounce and turn and there's another edge. Doesn't carry to anybody though this time, much to Stokes' fortune. Falls away on the off side and two runs are taken.

ANOTHER DROP! This time it's the keeper who's spilled it. Another straighter one from Keshav Maharaj, Stokes once again comes ahead to defend but gets a feather as it goes back. Quinton de Kock cannot hold on to it and Ben Stokes has been given another life. How unlucky can the left-arm spinner get?

DROPPED AND FOUR! Oh, dear lord... How has he missed that? Hashim Amla of all people, he can't believe what he's done. Maharaj from over the wicket bowls a straighter one outside off, Stokes is forward to defend but gets an edge behind to first slip. It goes right through Hashim Amla's legs as he was unable to get low in time. It runs away to the third man fence for a boundary.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Shorter in length outside off, Morgan offers a back foot punch to the right of the cover fielder and both batsmen take off. David Miller there gets to the ball and has a shy at the striker's end, but misses.
Ben Stokes to bat next.
Drinks break!

OUT! JOE ROOT IS GONE! Quite unfortunate for him but this is some excellent work from Dwaine Pretorius. He flights it up there as Morgan drives it straight back in the bowler's direction. Pretorius gets down and manages to get some finger on it. The ball goes back and hits the stumps at the non-striker's end. Root had backed away a bit and probably a bit in trouble, his expression saying it all. The umpire has referred it and the replays show he's not made it back in. This is a big wicket for South Africa, he was looking in great touch and the breakthrough will be highly welcome.
This could spell trouble for Joe Root. His face isn't exactly filling anybody with confidence. He could be run out here. It's taken upstairs to the third umpire.
Sliding in on middle and leg, Root flicks it through square leg and takes one.
The England skipper drives this through the covers for one.
Length delivery curling away from the southpaw, Morgan with an open face attempts to run it down to third man but misses. The ball just about kisses the outside edge.
Fullish in length and fired around off, Eoin Morgan charges out and drives it straight to the man at mid off.
Cut away a bit square on the off side by Morgan. Single to end the over.
Rocks back to this shorter ball as Maharaj comes from around the wicket, punched away to the covers for a single.
Stays behind the line once more and keeps it out.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
From over the wicket, Eoin Morgan drives this full delivery to long on for a single.
From around the wicket, it's looped up on the stumps, Root leans across and paddles it fine down the leg side for an easy run.
On the fuller side of things, driven to mid off this time but for nothing.

FOUR! Finds the gap this time. That's an excellent shot from Eoin Morgan. It's full again outside off, he leans into the drive and creams it through the gap in the covers to send it across the boundary line.
Full and swerving away, Morgan leans ahead and drives it straight to the cover fielder.
Well outside off, angling across, Morgan has nothing to do with it.
Eoin Morgan is the next batsman in.

OUT! GONE! Pretorius gets the breakthrough. But more than him, Kagiso Rabada will be the one to be filled with joy. His mistake hasn't really cost his side much. Short and wide outside off, Hales goes for the cut but gets an edge. Quinton de Kock behind the stumps takes an excellent, sharp catch. Brilliant work. England lose another wicket. Alex Hales in his 7 innings against South Africa, has fallen short of scoring a fifty for the first time today. Unreal, isn't it? The Proteas will be lucky to see the back of this man.
Shorter length delivery outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
The short of length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side. Dot ball to end the over.

DROPPED AND SIX! Rabada's put down a dolly. Shocker. Hales decides to give the charge to the left-armer and looks to clear wide long on. Rabada out there in the deep runs to his right and puts his hands over his head to take it. It bursts right out and lobs over the rope for a biggie.
Joe Root leans forward to this full ball and drives it down to long off for a single.
Floats it right up there once again, it's worked to mid-wicket for nothing.
50-run stand between Hales and Root!

FOUR! Full and coming in on middle and leg, Root clears his front leg a bit and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket. There's nobody out there in the deep so it'll run across the rope for a boundary. This is good batting from Joe Root. The current batting pair has just started to accelerate a bit here now.
Continues from around the wicket and tosses it up on middle and off, some drift inside as Root plays it back down the track.
Short outside off, Hales cuts it behind point, where the point fielder makes a good diving stop keeping it down to two runs.
Full outside off, Root pushes it through covers for a run.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.
FOUR! Full on leg stump, Root flicks it wide of mid on, for the second boundary of the over.
Full and is driven back to the bowler.
FOUR! INNOVATION FROM ROOT! The keeper comes up to the stumps to prevent Root from running down the wicket, he instead goes down on one knee and plays the paddle and the ball races away to the fence.
The keeper is right up to the stumps. Probably to stop Joe Root from stepping out of his crease.
Played to the point region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Flighted ball, Root tries to drive it through the covers with the spin, but there is no spin whatsoever and the ball takes an inside edge and rolls to mid-wicket.
Floats it on off stump, Hales goes to heave it over mid-wicket but gets an inside edge to square leg and the batsman run a single.
Flatter on off stump, Root drives it to covers for a run.
Full toss ball, Hales belts it down to mid on for a run.
Quicker and full on off stump, Hales drives it to covers.
Keshav Maharaj will have a go with the ball.
flicked the length ball on the leg side for no run.
FOUR! SECOND BOUNDARY OFF THE OVER! The batsman gets to the pitch off the ball and flicks it between mid-wicket and mid on for a boundary. A good over for England.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Full on the pads off Root, who flicks it straight to square leg for no run.
FOUR! THEY MIGHT JUST ATTACK THE NEW BOWLER! Root comes down the track, meets the length ball on the full and belts it down the ground for a boundary.
Pretorius, starts off with a very full delivery which Root drives to mid on.
Dwaine Pretorius is brought into the bowling attack.
Short off a length ball, Root rocks back and pulls it beautifully but straight to fine leg only for a single.
Back of a length ball, Hales defends it off the back foot.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Full on the pads, Root misses out on the flick, it takes his pad and is collected by the keeper.
Full ball on middle, Hales drives it down to mid on for a run.
Hales drives the length ball on the up to mid on.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.
On the pads and Root flicks to behind square for a couple.
FOUR! EASY FOR ROOT! Short on the body of Root, who comes inside the line and pulls is down to fine leg for a boundary.
Short and wide outside off stump, Hales cuts it off the back foot, Behardien at point makes a brilliant stop diving to his left. Saves a certain boundary. But they get through for a run.
Full ball, Root drives it to covers and gets through for a quick single.
Length delivery outside off, the ball stays low. Root is confused on the pitch and gets stranded in middle. Cannot get forward nor go backward. Gets his bat really late down.
Back of a length ball, Root defends it off the back foot.
Length ball on off stump, Hales defends it off the front foot and gets an inside edge behind square leg for a run.
Goes for the slower one, but outside off stump, Hales guides it between third man and point for a couple.
Good bowling here from Rabada. Lands it on a length, Hales drives it on the up but straight to mid off.
Full ball on off stump, Hales pushes it to mid off.
Back of a length ball, Root pushes it to cover-point for a run.
FOUR! Good end to the over. That's a super shot. Short and outside off, Alex Hales backs away a bit and slaps it over extra cover to send it across the rope for a boundary.
Silly mid on comes in place...
Short ball angling down a bit, it's ducked and evaded. Hales looks at the square leg umpire asking whether that's a wide or not, gets a response in return. It's signalled as a wide.
Around off, Hales brings his bat in front of his chest and defends it down on the off side.
Comfortably done. Full and right on the pads, Root clips it down to fine leg for one.
Length ball outside off, Alex drops it in front of covers and hares across to complete the run.
Morris is extracting some good bounce off the deck, it's coming back in and rising on to Alex Hales, the batsman does well to get on top of the bounce and keep it down.
Seaming back in on a good length, Hales punches it down to mid on from within his crease.
Full and straight, going down leg a bit, goes off Joe Root's pads who looks to flick it across. A shout for a leg before but that was never going to be given.
On the shorter side of the length, it's pushed away in front of cover-point.
Keeps it in the corridor of uncertainty, Root covers the line and shoulders his arms to it.
Back of a length delivery very close to the off stump, Root stands tall and meets it with a straight bat.
Wide! Bangs in another short one, it's too short this time so the umpire calls it a wide.
Oh ho ho! Welcomes Joe Root with a ferocious bumper. Sharp, accurate and around off, Root just about manages to evade it.
Joe Root walks in at No.3.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Beaten for sheer pace. It's deadly, it's fast and takes the stumps with it all the way to Wales. What a ripper of a delivery from Kagiso Rabada. Yorker at over 90 mph, on middle and off, Jason Roy has no chance of digging this one out. It zips through and knocks the stumps after brushing off the pads. Got to feel sorry for the English opener, would have taken something really special to keep it at bay. Rabada draws first blood, Roy's brief stay has come to an end.
Bowls this fuller in length, driven to mid off and that'll be the end of the over.
Fraction straight in line, Hales walks across a step and is hit on the thigh pad as he looks to defend it out.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, Hales keeps it out with a straight blade.

That's in the air but sailed away over the fielder. Jason Roy is well forward to this length ball but it's moving away just a teeny tiny bit, it takes the outside edge and flies over Farhaan Behardien at backward point. Goes away towards third man as the batsmen take a single.
Short of a good length, just outside off, Roy once again stands his ground and blocks it back down the track.
Back of a length delivery angling in on the body, Jason Roy stays rooted inside his crease and works it down on the leg side.
Length ball on leg stump, Roy pushes it wide of mid on for a run.
Good follow up ball by Rabada, just outside off at a good pace and Roy lets the ball go through to the keeper.
Qucik short ball, Roy is late on the pull shot and gets an under edge onto his elbow. He might be in a little pain here.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Back of a length ball outside off, Roy drives it to the mid off fielder.
Roy pushes the length ball to mid on.
Lands it on a length on middle, Roy gets forward and pushes it to mid on.
Very full ball on leg stump, almost a yorker. Hales punches it to mid on.
Bowls it on a length, Hales defends it off the back foot.
FOUR! BAD LINE! Full angling into Hales' pads, he just drags it off the inner half it through mid-wicket for a boundary. Poor line there by Morris. Hales gets his first boundary.
Full and swinging wide of off stump, Hales leans forward and drives it to covers, who dives to his right and stops the ball.
Back of a length ball, Hales defends it off the back foot.
Chris Morris will bowl from the other end with the second new ball. He too will have two slips in place.
Bowled outside off and the batsman lets the ball go through to the keeper.
FOUR! PURE TIMING! Length ball on middle stump, Roy walks across and flicks it through the vacant mid-wicket area and the ball races away to the fence. First boundary of the day.
Back of a length on middle, Roy walks across and flicks it behind square leg for a couple. Roy gets off the mark.
Bowls it on a length, nips away off the wicket, Roy defends it off the front foot onto the ground.
Lands on a length outside off, Roy lets it go through to the keeper.
Length ball on off stump, defended to backward point. Good start by Rabada.

We are all set to get underway. The players and the umpires have made their way out in the middle. Overcast conditions, a good chill and we're ready to get things going. Jason Roy and Alex Hales will open the batting for England while Kagiso Rabada will lead the South African bowling charge. Two slips are in place. Here we go...

TOSS - SOUTH AFRICA WIN THE TOSS AND WILL HAVE A BOWL FIRST! The hosts have made one change - Chris Woakes makes way for Jake Ball. South Africa have three changes - Imran Tahir, Wayne Parnell and JP Duminy are replaced by Keshav Maharaj (Debut), Dwaine Pretorius and Farhaan Behardien.

This series is all about both teams finding some rhythm going into the Champions Trophy. Today will be a good test for both sides. Playing under pressure will surely benefit them going into the all-important tournament. Beating the No.1 ODI side in the world would have surely done a world of good for the Englishmen. Can they extend their 7-match winning run or will be see the Saffas turn it up under these cloudy conditions in Southampton?

The Rose Bowl will host the second Royal London ODI where South Africa go into this game with the objective of staying alive in the series. The Proteas suffered a big loss in the series opener against an England unit which looks impenetrable in the 50-over format. Eoin Morgan led from the front in the previous encounter with a superb ton and the total posted as a result of that proved to be too much for AB de Villiers' men.
